title: Deogen: Automatic Benchmark Generation for Reasoning over Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.38687v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models are increasingly being deployed in regulated settings, where a model must apply given rules to the facts of a situation to determine a verdict. Benchmarking this capability, known as deontic reasoning, remains a costly and manual process, with existing datasets largely hand-crafted. In this paper, we present DeoGen, a scalable, automatic, and parametrizable benchmark generator for deontic reasoning. By autoformalizing policy rules to first-order logic, we can construct decision trees that capture possible outcome trajectories. Each path down a tree becomes a benchmark entry, with each tree producing combinatorially many entries relative to tree depth. Paths ending at a leaf entail a verdict, while non-leaf paths measure a model's ability to abstain when presented with insufficient information. translated_title: Deogen：面向规则推理的自动基准生成
translated_abstract: 语言模型正越来越多地被部署在受监管的环境中，模型需要将给定的规则应用于具体情境的事实，从而作出裁决。对这种被称为“义务性推理”的能力进行基准测试，目前仍是一个成本高昂且依赖人工的过程，现有数据集大多是手工构建的。在本文中，我们提出了DeoGen，一个可扩展、自动化且可参数化的义务性推理基准生成器。通过将政策规则自动形式化为一阶逻辑，我们能够构建刻画可能结果轨迹的决策树。树中的每条路径都成为一个基准条目，每棵树相对于其深度可产生组合级数量的条目。终止于叶节点的路径蕴含一个裁决结果，而未达叶节点的路径则用于衡量模型在信息不足时进行弃权（拒绝回答）的能力。评估结果显示，前沿模型在89%-92%的情况下能够给出正确的裁决。值得注意的是，其性能在（摘要原文在此处截断）方面显著下降，正确率仅为22%-40%。
tldr: 该论文提出DeoGen，通过将政策规则自动形式化为一阶逻辑并构建决策树来自动生成可扩展的义务性推理基准，揭示出前沿模型虽能以89%-92%的准确率作出正确裁决，但在信息不足需要弃权时性能大幅下降（仅22%-40%正确）。
en_tdlr: DeoGen is an automatic, scalable benchmark generator for deontic reasoning that autoformalizes policy rules into first-order logic and constructs decision trees, revealing that frontier models achieve 89-92% verdict accuracy but degrade sharply (22-40%) when required to abstain under insufficient information.
